senses.gloss: जिन जि + न, n. A name of Buddha. Pañc. 236, 8.

जीन जीन,
 I. ptcple. pf. pass. of ज्या.
 II. n. A leathern pouch, Man. 11, 138.

जिन्व् जिन्व् (originally जि + नु, ii. 5; cf. γάνυμαι for γαι + νυμαι; akin to दिव्, जीव्, and जू), i. 1, Par.
 1. To be brisk (ved.).
 2. To further (ved.).
 3. To help, Chr. 296, 1; 6, 9 = Rigv. i. 112, 1 []; 6; 9.
 4. To love, Chr. 290, 6 = Rigv. i. 64, 8.
 --† i. 10, To speak (? v. r.)
